description: Find leagues (competitions) of a sport and their ids, optionally by name or country (also matches official_name, the competition's official or Wikidata name where known). Free.

lang.description: language of team, league and country names: de, es, it or fr (default English)

query.description: text the league or country name must contain, e.g. 'Premier League' or 'Germany'

sport.description: sport: soccer, basketball, baseball, hockey, tennis, handball, volleyball, american-football, cricket, rugby (union), rugby-league, esports or table-tennis

name: find_leagues
